# ============================================================================
# changelog_blacklist.txt - Excluded Path & Filename Patterns for Changelog
# ============================================================================
# One regex pattern per line (matched case-insensitively against repo paths).
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# ============================================================================

# XUnity AutoTranslator auto-generated dumps
_AutoGeneratedTranslations.*\.txt$

# Backup, archive, and temporary working files/folders
\.bak(\d+|up)?$
\.rar$
\.7z$
\.zip$
\.psd$
\.tmp$
(^|/)New folder(/|$)
(^|/)\[Dump\](/|$)
(^|/)Template(/|$)
Thumbs\.db$
desktop\.ini$
